_comment: Hearthbound (End Remastered eye coverage): widens minecraft:has_structure/woodland_mansion, which gates endrem:magical_eye. Deliberately the smallest patch here. A mansion is themed to dark oak, so it gets only the dark, dense forest analogues -- not the whole forest class, which would make mansions common. endrem:magical_eye also drops from evokers (5%), and evokers spawn in raids at any village, so this eye is obtainable without a mansion at all; this only stops modded dark forests from being mansion-proof. replace:false merges on top of whatever the jars ended up with, and this datapack loads after mod jars, so it also lands on top of a mod's replace:true. Regenerate with .claude/tools/gen-endrem-eye-coverage.js; measure with .claude/tools/endrem-eye-audit.js.
